sections.subhead: Launch or Rebuild Your Online Store on WordPress's Most Trusted Ecommerce Platform

body.text: Teknoppy builds WooCommerce stores in Kochi on WordPress - set up with your products, shipping, GST and payment options, designed to sell, and ready in 3-6 weeks. You own the store, the content and the customer data, with no platform subscription.

Choosing the right WooCommerce team in Kochi matters because a poorly configured store causes slow checkouts, failed payments, and lost sales long after launch. As an experienced WordPress development team, we engineer stores for speed, high conversion, and seamless order fulfillment.

items.html: 100% Store & Data Ownership: Unlike hosted SaaS platforms, your WordPress store, customer database, and order records belong entirely to you with zero monthly platform subscriptions.
Domestic & International Gateways: We configure Razorpay, Cashfree, UPI, Stripe, PayPal, and Telr/PayTabs for domestic Indian and GCC cross-border shoppers. See our Payment Gateway Integration.

Engineered for Speed: Clean code, server-level object caching (Redis), lightweight theme frameworks, and WebP image optimization to ensure sub-2-second load times.

items.q: How is WooCommerce different from Shopify?
items.a: WooCommerce is an open-source platform running on WordPress, giving you complete ownership of your store code, data, and hosting with zero recurring platform percentage fees. Shopify is a closed hosted subscription platform that is fast to start but offers less flexibility and incurs recurring app subscriptions.

items.q: How much does a WooCommerce store cost in Kochi?
items.a: A starter WooCommerce store in Kochi typically costs ₹45,000 to ₹75,000, while a custom-designed store with advanced integrations ranges from ₹75,000 to ₹1,50,000. Enterprise stores with wholesale B2B pricing or ERP sync start from ₹1,50,000.

items.q: What are the ongoing running costs of a WooCommerce store?
items.a: WooCommerce itself has no monthly platform fees. Ongoing costs consist solely of your web hosting (typically ₹5,000 to ₹15,000 annually), domain renewal, payment gateway transaction fees, and optional commercial plugin renewals.

items.q: Can WooCommerce accept UPI and handle Indian GST?
items.a: Yes. We configure domestic gateways like Razorpay and Cashfree that support all UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm). We also configure GST percentage rates by product category, automatic HSN code invoices, and interstate IGST/CGST rules.

items.q: Can you migrate our existing store to WooCommerce?
items.a: Yes. We manage complete store migrations from Shopify, Magento, Wix, or OpenCart, transferring your products, descriptions, customer accounts, and historical order data with minimal downtime.

items.q: How long does WooCommerce store development take?
items.a: A standard custom store typically takes 3 to 6 weeks from initial requirements review to live launch, depending on product count, custom design requirements, and payment gateway approvals.
